summary: PHP2Shell moved to confirmed in-the-wild exploitation against a European government target while Censys counts 32.4M services still exposed; eMudhra fallout widened with 106K rogue certificates minted as the CA exits the TLS business, and fresh disclosures include AGENTS.md agent hijacking, unpatched Tailscale SSH privilege escalation, Brotli HTTP2Shell defenses, and a Chinese-linked ConnectWise supply-chain breach.
